_comment: Events layer for the Australia trip, Dec 2026 - Feb 2027. Research for kilbot/holidays#20. Researched 2026-08-27; every entry's sources were accessed on that date. Currency AUD. 'rough_ticket_cost_couple_aud' is for two people; cost_confidence tells you whether the number is sourced or an estimate. Traveller weighting: 'her' = psytrance/doof/hippie-market taste (first-class sway); 'him' = sport (MINOR only - never justifies a big spend or a relocation); 'both' = works for the pair. sway: high | medium | low | none | blocked (blocked = would sway placement but collides with a hard anchor).
structural_finding: The Australian bush-doof / psytrance calendar deliberately AVOIDS December-February. Peak fire danger, total fire bans and extreme heat push the scene into Sep-Nov and Feb-Apr. Rainbow Spirit (ex-Rainbow Serpent) said so in writing when it permanently abandoned its Australia Day slot. Consequence: the psytrance hunt for this window yields an NYE festival cluster (which collides with the Sydney NYE anchor), then near-silence until early February. Hippie/artisan markets run year-round, are free, and are the reliable substitute.

name: Australia v New Zealand, 1st Test
why_it_matters: Lands squarely in the Perth home-base block, where lodging is free and a car is borrowed. Cheap general-admission day out with zero relocation cost. Per the taste profile this is a MINOR line item - tag it, do not build around it.
booking_urgency: low - Perth Tests rarely sell out on GA

name: Twilight Hawkers Market
dates: Every Friday 16:30-21:00, spring and summer season
why_it_matters: Free, weekly, 40+ stalls and live music. Zero-cost way to give her a market night while Perth-based. Any Friday in the December block works.

name: Fremantle Markets
dates: Every Friday, Saturday and Sunday, 09:00-18:00, year-round
why_it_matters: The heritage-listed Perth market and the closest WA equivalent to the Northern Rivers hippie-market vibe. Open three days a week, so it never constrains the calendar - any Fri/Sat/Sun of the Perth block picks it up.

name: Margaret River Farmers Market
why_it_matters: Saturday-only. If the Margaret River capsule is 2-3 days it should straddle a Saturday morning, otherwise it is missed entirely. Cheap placement lever.

name: Leeuwin Estate Concert Series (flagship)
dates: TBA - no 2026/27 concert announced; series appears dormant. Re-check Oct 2026
why_it_matters: The issue asked to check this. The official 'Upcoming Concerts' page still carries a COVID-era holding statement and lists nothing. The big-name lawn concert that would have justified a Margaret River date-lock is NOT currently on. Do not plan the WA southwest around it.

name: Summer Music by the Gallery Cellar (Leeuwin Estate)
place: Leeuwin Estate Art Gallery Cellar Door, Margaret River
dates: Sunday afternoons from 29 Dec 2026 through January 2027
dates_status: reported - recurring pattern, 2026/27 season not yet re-confirmed. Re-check Nov 2026
why_it_matters: The live-music-at-Leeuwin substitute that IS running: local musicians, Sunday afternoons, wine and cheese boxes. Note the clash: it starts 29 Dec, by which point the itinerary has them in Sydney. Only reachable if a WA southwest block is pushed very late, which the NYE anchor forbids.

name: Meredith Music Festival
why_it_matters: Australia's most beloved camping festival, and it falls in the WA/Christmas half of the trip. Ballot-allocated and typically exhausted long before December. Logged as a near-miss, not an option.

name: Rolex Sydney Hobart Yacht Race - Boxing Day start
why_it_matters: Free harbour spectacle, watchable from any headland - genuinely a both-of-them event rather than a sport ticket. BUT 26 Dec is the PER->SYD flight day and also the 10am release of Opera House Forecourt NYE tickets. Do not try to stack all three.

name: Boxing Day Test, Australia v New Zealand
why_it_matters: Logged for completeness. Collides head-on with the Sydney NYE anchor and the PER->SYD flight. A Melbourne detour for it is exactly the kind of sport-driven relocation the taste profile rules out.

name: Woodford Folk Festival (39th)
place: Woodfordia, Woodford, QLD (1h north of Brisbane)
why_it_matters: The flagship Australian hippie gathering - six days, 2,000+ performers, huge artisan market, workshops, fire event on NYE. On pure taste this is the single best-fitting event of the entire window for her. It is ALSO a direct collision with the Sydney NYE hard anchor. Flagged so the trade-off is made consciously rather than by accident.
rough_ticket_cost_couple_aud: day passes from ~50/couple; full festival + camping ~1,100-1,500/couple
cost_confidence: part-sourced (official range A$25-745 pp; couple totals estimated)
on_sale_status: public tickets ON SALE NOW; program and lineup announced mid-October 2026
booking_urgency: high if it is ever going to be chosen - camping sells through

name: Taste of Summer (formerly Taste of Tasmania)
why_it_matters: Hobart's summer food-and-music week, free entry, pay per plate. Only reachable if the Tasmania capsule moves to the NYE window - which the Sydney anchor forbids. With Tasmania planned for early February this is a miss; the Feb equivalents are the Wooden Boat Festival and the Regatta.

name: Lost Paradise
place: Glenworth Valley, Darkinjung Country, NSW (~1h north of Sydney)
why_it_matters: THE biggest tension in the whole calendar. A four-day bush camping festival an hour from Sydney that covers NYE itself - forest doof-adjacent staging, wellness/workshop program, and a 2026/27 lineup led by John Summit, Skepta, KI/KI, Overmono, Nia Archives and Armand Van Helden. It is the only NYE option in the window that serves her taste, and it is mutually exclusive with the Sydney Harbour NYE hard anchor. Decide this deliberately.
rough_ticket_cost_couple_aud: 1,250-1,600 all-in (4-day A$589.99 pp + fees, plus camping/vehicle passes)
cost_confidence: part-sourced (ticket tiers sourced; couple all-in estimated)
booking_urgency: high - sells out most years; and the Sydney NYE lodging block would have to be unwound

name: Beyond The Valley
why_it_matters: Victoria's NYE camping festival. Same collision as Lost Paradise but with a worse geography penalty (Melbourne rather than an hour from Sydney). Listed for completeness; Lost Paradise dominates it for this trip.

name: Great Escape NYE Camping Music Festival
dates_status: likely - 2026/27 edition listed but not independently confirmed. Re-check Sep 2026
why_it_matters: Tasmania's NYE camping festival, three stages, BYO alcohol, yoga, DJs into the early hours - the 2025/26 edition was headlined by Spacey Jane, Lime Cordiale, The Presets and Thelma Plum. The only reason it matters here: if the NYE anchor ever moved, Tasmania-at-New-Year becomes a coherent alternative shape. It does not fit the current plan.
on_sale_status: 2025/26 tickets opened 5 Sep; expect a similar early-September on-sale for 2026/27

name: NYE On The Hill
why_it_matters: Small, well-liked Victorian NYE camping festival. Same anchor collision. Listed for completeness only.

name: Wildlands Festival Brisbane
why_it_matters: One-day NYE electronic festival (John Summit, Skepta, WORSHIP, KI/KI). Direct collision with the Sydney anchor; no camping, so none of the doof texture she actually wants. Low priority.

name: Wildlands Festival Perth
why_it_matters: Cruel timing: the one sizeable electronic festival in Perth lands two days after they have left WA for good. Logged as an unavoidable miss.

name: Field Day
why_it_matters: New Year's Day festival in the Domain, walkable from the Sydney block. The one electronic event that is compatible with the NYE anchor rather than competing with it - but it is a hard day-after ask and 1 Jan is also the cheap-recovery day the Sydney capsule assumes.
booking_urgency: low - decide after the lineup drops

name: New Year's Test, Australia v New Zealand
why_it_matters: Day 1 falls on 4 Jan, the last day of the Sydney capsule's 'ideal' 6-night shape. A cheap optional afternoon that requires no schedule change at all. MINOR - already priced inside the capsule's attractions allowance.

name: Sydney Festival
place: City-wide: The Domain, Carriageworks, Opera House, Parramatta
dates_status: reported - confirm against sydneyfestival.org.au when the 2027 program lands (late Oct 2026)
why_it_matters: Large slice of the program is free, including Domain concerts and outdoor installations. If the Sydney block extends past 6 Jan, or if a Sydney re-touch happens on the way out, this makes those days cheap and interesting. Does not on its own justify staying.
rough_ticket_cost_couple_aud: 0 for the free program; 120-300 per ticketed show

name: Cygnet Folk Festival
why_it_matters: A genuinely hippie village folk festival in the Huon Valley - buskers, markets, workshops, whole-town takeover. Strong taste fit. The problem is purely calendrical: it sits a month before the planned early-February Tasmania block and right on top of the reef window. Only reachable by rebuilding the January half of the trip around it.
cost_confidence: estimate (official prices not published on the public page; booking fee 2.25% + $0.40 per ticket)
booking_urgency: medium - only if the Tasmania block moves to January

name: The Channon Craft Market
place: Coronation Park, The Channon, NSW (Byron hinterland)
dates: 2nd Sunday of every month, 09:00-15:00. In window: 13 Dec 2026, 10 Jan 2027, 14 Feb 2027
why_it_matters: The single most important recurring entry in this dataset for her. The Channon is the original Northern Rivers counterculture craft market - handmade-only, festival atmosphere, the direct descendant of the Aquarius-era scene. CRITICAL PLACEMENT PROBLEM: with the Byron block at 27 Jan - 2 Feb they miss every occurrence. 13 Dec they are in WA; 10 Jan is inside the reef window; 14 Feb is after the likely departure. Catching it requires the Byron block to include Sun 10 Jan.
booking_urgency: none - but it is a date-placement constraint

name: Ocean Sounds Festival
why_it_matters: One-day boutique festival. Only relevant if a Melbourne/Victoria block appears in early January, which the current flow does not include.

name: Australian Open 2027
dates: 2027-01-11 to 2027-01-31 (Opening Week 11-16 Jan; finals weekend 30-31 Jan)
why_it_matters: RE-RANKED DOWN. The previous Australia Day recommendation leaned on the AO being in quarter/semi-final week on 26 Jan. Under the taste profile the AO is a MINOR line: a cheap ground-pass afternoon if they are already in Melbourne, never a reason to fly there. Also note the AO inflates Melbourne lodging for the whole of January.
rough_ticket_cost_couple_aud: 98+ for two ground passes; reserved seats considerably more
booking_urgency: low for ground passes; high for reserved night sessions

name: Toyota Tamworth Country Music Festival (55th)
why_it_matters: Ten days of largely free street entertainment. Wrong genre for her taste and badly off-route (inland NSW). Logged because it is the reason inland-NSW accommodation is scarce and expensive in mid-January if any drive routes that way.

name: Midsumma Festival
place: Melbourne, city-wide; Pride March on Fitzroy St, St Kilda
why_it_matters: Three weeks of queer arts and party culture running straight through the Australia Day window and out the other side. A far better argument for being in Melbourne in late January than the tennis is, and much of it is free or cheap. Pride March on 31 Jan is the peak.
rough_ticket_cost_couple_aud: 0 for Carnival and Pride March; 80-200 per ticketed show

name: Byron Community Market
dates: 1st Sunday of the month, 08:00-15:00, PLUS a bonus 3rd Sunday in December and January. In window: 6 Dec 2026, 20 Dec 2026, 3 Jan 2027, 17 Jan 2027, 7 Feb 2027
why_it_matters: 300+ stalls, the biggest market in the shire. The summer bonus dates matter: 17 Jan 2027 is an extra Sunday edition. With a 27 Jan - 2 Feb Byron block they miss it by five days at each end - another argument for nudging the Byron dates.

name: FRINGE WORLD Festival
why_it_matters: The third-largest fringe in the world and WA's biggest annual event - and it starts three and a half weeks after they leave Perth. A structural argument that the WA half of this trip is in the wrong month for festivals; WA's festival season is Jan-Mar, theirs is December.

name: Bangalow Market
dates: 4th Sunday of the month, 08:00-15:00. In window: 27 Dec 2026, 24 Jan 2027, 28 Feb 2027
why_it_matters: The prettiest and most craft-heavy of the hinterland markets. Sun 24 Jan 2027 sits three days BEFORE the proposed Byron block opens. Shifting the Byron capsule to start Sat 23 or Sun 24 Jan captures it - and lands them in the hinterland for Australia Day, which is where the taste profile actually wants them.

name: Nimbin Markets
dates: 4th AND 5th Sunday of the month, 08:30-14:30. In window: 27 Dec 2026, 24 Jan 2027, 31 Jan 2027, 28 Feb 2027
why_it_matters: Nimbin is the counterculture capital and the market is the purest expression of it. Sunday 31 Jan 2027 is a FIFTH Sunday, which means the market runs - and it lands INSIDE the proposed 27 Jan - 2 Feb Byron block. This is the one flagship hippie market the current itinerary already catches for free. Protect it.

name: Mullumbimby Farmers Market and Community Market
dates: Farmers Market every Friday 07:00-11:00; Community Market 3rd Saturday of the month
why_it_matters: The weekly Friday farmers market is the easy win - Fri 29 Jan 2027 falls inside the proposed Byron block with no schedule change at all. Mullumbimby is the hinterland's hippie town proper.

name: Byron Artisan Market
dates: Every Saturday evening 16:00-21:00 through spring and summer
why_it_matters: Weekly Saturday-night handmade market with live music - Sat 30 Jan 2027 falls inside the proposed Byron block. Free, no planning cost.

name: Uki Buttery Bazaar and Federal Village Market
dates: Both 3rd Sunday of the month (Federal 08:00-14:00). In window: 20 Dec 2026, 17 Jan 2027, 21 Feb 2027
why_it_matters: Small hinterland village markets, deep-cut versions of the Channon. Both fall on 3rd Sundays, so they share the same miss as the Byron Community Market summer edition.

name: Eumundi Markets
why_it_matters: 600+ stalls, the biggest artisan market in Queensland and a direct taste match. Runs twice a week so it never constrains dates - but it is only reachable if the itinerary touches the Sunshine Coast, which the current Cairns/Byron shape does not. Worth a day if a Brisbane transit ever appears.

name: Salamanca Market
why_it_matters: Tasmania's flagship market, 300 stalls. Saturday-only: the Tasmania block MUST contain a Saturday. With the Wooden Boat Festival on 5-8 Feb 2027, Sat 6 Feb gives Salamanca Market + Wooden Boat Festival + Royal Hobart Regatta on one day, walking distance apart. That is the single best-value day in the whole February half of the trip.

name: Australia Day / Invasion Day - Sydney (WugulOra, Harbourfest, Ferrython, Yabun)
place: Barangaroo, Circular Quay, Victoria Park Camperdown
dates_status: confirmed for Yabun; wider program published Dec 2026/Jan 2027
why_it_matters: Best 26 January program in the country and, crucially, the best one under the NEW taste lens too: YABUN FESTIVAL at Victoria Park is free, Aboriginal-owned and led, 65,000+ people, and is structurally a music-and-market day - live stages, market stalls, panels, dance - not a flag-and-fireworks day. WugulOra dawn ceremony at Barangaroo, Harbourfest and the Ferrython (free tickets, limited, released in January) fill the middle. Still the wrong geography for this trip: it backtracks against an east/north flow and re-runs a harbour they already saw at maximum on 31 Dec.
booking_urgency: low - but Ferrython tickets go instantly

name: Australia Day / Invasion Day - Melbourne (Share the Spirit, Fed Square, Invasion Day rally)
place: Treasury Gardens, Federation Square, Parliament House
why_it_matters: The Melbourne recommendation SURVIVES the re-rank but on completely different grounds. SHARE THE SPIRIT FESTIVAL at Treasury Gardens, 12:00-18:30, free, is Victoria's longest-running First Peoples festival - Indigenous folk, country, rock, blues, soul, funk and hip hop, family-friendly and alcohol-free, run by Songlines Aboriginal Music Corporation. That is a real music festival for her, on the day, for nothing. Fed Square runs a free 10:00-19:00 public-holiday program. Melbourne's official day is deliberately muted (no street parade since 2023). The AO and the BBL final are now footnotes, not the argument.

name: BBL|16 Final
place: Venue TBC - home ground of the higher-ranked finalist
dates_status: date confirmed, venue TBC after the league stage ends 17 Jan 2027
why_it_matters: RE-RANKED DOWN to a footnote. The BBL final is scheduled on Australia Day, but the venue is not known until after 17 January and could be any of eight cities. Building a 26 January plan on a fixture whose city is unknown nine days out was always fragile; under the taste profile it is also one-sided. Tag and ignore.

name: Australia Day - Perth (Langley Park drone and fireworks). Skyworks is DEAD.
why_it_matters: Answering the issue's question directly: SKYWORKS NO LONGER EXISTS. The City of Perth ran it 1985-2022 and ended it after the 2022 edition on cost, environmental and waning-interest grounds. Since 2023 the replacement is a smaller Langley Park event - afternoon family zone from 15:00, food trucks, BYO picnic zone from 18:30, and a 30-minute combined drone-and-fireworks show from 20:30 synced to FM 89.3. It is a decent local night, not a national spectacle - and it is moot for this trip, which leaves WA on 26 December.

name: Australia Day / Survival Day - Adelaide (Survival Day Tandanyangga, Aus Lights on the River)
place: Victoria Square Tarntanyangga and Elder Park Tarntanya Wama, Adelaide
why_it_matters: Adelaide's shape is Survival Day Tandanyangga in Victoria Square (12:00-17:00) plus a morning smoking ceremony at Elder Park and the free Aus Lights on the River in the evening. Perfectly respectable and entirely off-route - Adelaide is not on this itinerary and nothing here justifies adding it. Note also that the 2026 Aus Lights evening was cancelled for extreme heat, which is a live risk for any outdoor 26 January plan.

name: Australia Day Fun - Cairns Esplanade
why_it_matters: Free community afternoon and evening on the Esplanade, roughly midday to 21:00, with local bands and fireworks. A council event for residents. If the reef block owns 18-31 January this is a fine, low-effort way to spend the day - but it is not a reason to be there and not a reason to leave. Expect a 10-15% public-holiday surcharge on restaurants and some closures.

name: Saltwater Freshwater Festival
place: Rotates between Mid North Coast NSW communities (Coffs Harbour, Kempsey, Port Macquarie, Forster)
why_it_matters: Free Aboriginal cultural festival on 26 January celebrating the Gumbaynggirr, Dunghutti, Biripi and Worimi nations - live music, dance, art market. Relevant only if a Sydney-to-Byron coastal drive is on the table, in which case it makes 26 January a destination on the road rather than a dead travel day.

name: Frequency Forest - January / Australia Day edition
place: Maitland Showground, Hunter Valley, NSW (2h north of Sydney)
dates: RUMOUR / TBA - a January edition ran 23-26 Jan 2026 (Australia Day long weekend). Only the September 2026 edition is announced. Re-check Oct 2026
why_it_matters: The single most interesting UNCONFIRMED lead in this sweep. Frequency Forest is a two-stage camping festival running techno, hard dance, psy-tech and progressive psytrance, and it ran an Australia Day-weekend edition in January 2026. If a January 2027 edition happens it would be the only psytrance camping festival inside the trip window that is not blocked by an anchor - and it would be a real answer to 'where should they be on Australia Day'. Treat as speculative until announced.
booking_urgency: re-check October 2026, then decide fast if it appears

name: Midsumma Pride March
why_it_matters: Free, huge, street-party energy on the last Sunday of January. If Melbourne ends up as the departure city, this is a much better final-weekend anchor than any sport fixture.

name: Party In The Paddock (14th)
place: Quercus Park, Carrick, TAS (15 min from Launceston)
why_it_matters: THE headline sway-event of the February half. A four-day camping music festival in northern Tasmania that lands exactly on the planned early-February Tasmania block, returning for its 14th year after a record-breaking 2026. It is the only in-window camping festival that does not fight a hard anchor. Direct tension with the Wooden Boat Festival (5-8 Feb, Hobart) 200km south - the Tasmania capsule cannot have both at full strength, so this is a real fork.
on_sale_status: NOT YET ON SALE. Lineup historically announced October; tickets historically early November
booking_urgency: HIGH - set a reminder for late October 2026 and buy in the first release

name: Australian Wooden Boat Festival
place: Hobart waterfront, Franklin Wharf and Princes Wharf
why_it_matters: Biennial, free to attend, four days of tall ships, classic vessels, exhibitions, talks, workshops, food and live music. Parade of Sail Friday 5 Feb at midday; Admiral's Sail closes it Monday 8 Feb at 16:00. Because it is biennial, missing it costs two years. Sat 6 Feb stacks it with Salamanca Market and the Royal Hobart Regatta in one walkable day.
rough_ticket_cost_couple_aud: free entry (food, drink, paid sails extra)
on_sale_status: free entry; some sails and talks ticketed
booking_urgency: medium - Hobart lodging spikes for this week, book by December

name: Royal Hobart Regatta (188th)
why_it_matters: Free waterfront spectacle that overlaps the Wooden Boat Festival exactly, and Monday 8 Feb is a southern-Tasmania public holiday (expect closures and holiday pricing). Sport-tagged but genuinely a both-of-them free day out rather than a ticketed fixture.

name: Sydney Lunar New Year Festival (Year of the Fire Goat)
dates_status: reported - City of Sydney program published Dec/Jan
why_it_matters: Largely free street festival. Relevant only if the departure is from Sydney in the second week of February - in which case it makes the final days cheap and lively.

name: Laneway Festival 2027
place: Centennial Park Sydney (12 Feb); Brisbane Showgrounds (13 Feb); Flemington Park Melbourne (19 Feb)
why_it_matters: If the departure slips to the mid-February end of the range, Sydney on Fri 12 Feb or Brisbane on Sat 13 Feb is a strong last-night-in-Australia option - and Brisbane on 13 Feb is a two-hour drive from Byron. Adelaide and Perth are sitting 2027 out.
on_sale_status: dates announced; tickets not yet on general sale
booking_urgency: medium if the trip tail extends past 12 Feb

name: Summer Campout
place: Australia - state and venue not published
dates_status: rumor - single-source listing, location unconfirmed. Re-check Nov 2026
why_it_matters: The only doof-scene event listed anywhere inside December-February beyond the NYE cluster. Appears on a psytrance festival calendar with dates but no state, venue, capacity, lineup or ticket link. Do not plan around it; re-check whether it firms up, because if it lands anywhere on the east coast it would be the one true doof of the trip.
sway: low (would be high if confirmed on the east coast)

name: St Kilda Festival
why_it_matters: Australia's largest free all-ages music festival, on the beach. Falls after the outer edge of the departure range (late Jan - mid Feb), so it is almost certainly a miss - but if the tail ever stretches to 20 Feb it is a free headline weekend.

name: Nannup Music Festival
why_it_matters: WA's hippie village folk festival, an hour from Margaret River, and a very strong taste match - but it runs over the WA Labour Day long weekend at the end of February, two months after they leave the state and after the departure window. A structural miss, logged so it is not rediscovered as a false hope.

name: Adelaide Fringe
why_it_matters: Southern hemisphere's biggest fringe, but it opens after the departure window and Adelaide is off-route. Logged for completeness.

name: Perth Festival
dates: February - March 2027, exact dates TBC. Re-check Oct 2026
why_it_matters: Australia's oldest arts festival and, like Fringe World, entirely outside the WA half of this trip. Reinforces the finding that the Perth block is scheduled a month before WA's festival season starts.

name: Sydney Gay and Lesbian Mardi Gras Parade
why_it_matters: Three weeks past the outer departure edge. Logged only to close the question - no version of this itinerary reaches it.
rough_ticket_cost_couple_aud: free to watch; grandstand tickets extra

name: Esoteric Festival - RULED OUT
dates: N/A - no viable 2027 edition. Re-check administration outcome anytime
why_it_matters: The issue asked specifically. Answer: it is not a plannable event. The 2025 edition was cancelled the night before it opened when the municipal building surveyor refused a POPE permit, days after the council had approved it. The company then went into voluntary administration owing more than A$2.8 million to ticketholders, suppliers, contractors and staff. Even if it returns it is a March event, outside the window. Do not put money on it.

name: Rainbow Serpent Festival, now Rainbow Spirit Festival - RULED OUT (moved off summer)
dates: N/A in window - permanently moved off the Australia Day slot; 2027 edition reported for early March
why_it_matters: The obvious hope - Australia's most famous psytrance festival, historically on the Australia Day long weekend - and it is dead for this trip. It was renamed Rainbow Spirit in July 2023 over cultural-appropriation concerns, and it moved off summer permanently: organisers wrote that 'the increased temperatures and fire risk over summer has become a real concern (especially with our lovely site being adjacent to a forest reserve)'. That single sentence explains the whole empty January in this dataset.

name: Earth Frequency Festival (21st) - RULED OUT (October)
why_it_matters: Queensland's cornerstone bush doof - psytrance, bushprog, techno, markets, community. It used to sit in February at Ivory's Rock; it has now moved to late October at Woodfordia. Another instance of the scene vacating the summer. No 2027 edition announced.

name: Subsonic Music Festival - RULED OUT (November)
why_it_matters: Riverside camping doof 3.5 hours north of Sydney, 120+ artists across four stages. Misses by roughly a month. Logged because it was named in the issue.

name: Rabbits Eat Lettuce - RULED OUT (Easter)
place: Bushland Hideaway, Beebo, QLD (NSW/QLD border country)
why_it_matters: The border-country doof, and the closest thing in Australia to the festival she would most want. It is an Easter event and Easter 2027 is late March. Misses the departure window by six weeks at best. Named in the issue, so closed out explicitly.

name: Pitch Music and Arts - RULED OUT (March)
why_it_matters: Victoria's Labour Day weekend camping festival. Out of window; logged to complete the picture of where the scene actually lives in the calendar.

name: Mona Foma - DEFUNCT (do not cite)
why_it_matters: Confirmed dead. MONA has cancelled future plans for the festival. Any older itinerary or blog that puts Mona Foma in the January/February Tasmania slot is stale. MONA the museum is of course still open and is a separate line item for the Tasmania capsule.

name: Falls Festival - DEFUNCT for this window (do not cite)
place: Byron Bay NSW, Marion Bay TAS, Lorne VIC
why_it_matters: Falls used to be the New Year festival at Byron and Marion Bay and is still listed as 'annual' by lazy tourism copy. It is not running. If a source claims Falls Byron over New Year 2026/27, that source is stale - discard the rest of its dates too.
